name: Jace Beleren
description: Jace Beleren is a planeswalker from Vryn and perhaps the most talented mind mage in the Multiverse, known as the Living Guildpact of Ravnica and as a member of the Gatewatch.

summary.text: Jace Beleren is a planeswalker from Vryn and perhaps the most talented mind mage in the Multiverse, known as the Living Guildpact of Ravnica and as a member of the Gatewatch.

bio.text: As the Living Guildpact on Ravnica, Jace outwitted the gorgon Vraska with illusions, and later agreed to help Gideon solve the puzzle of the leylines on Zendikar, admitting to himself that he had inadvertently released the Eldrazi.
On Zendikar he met Ugin at the Eye, devised a hedron trap that imprisoned Ulamog, and then, with Nissa, planned the last stand that drained the titans through the leylines.
He swore the oath that founded the Gatewatch, then went to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov, where he confronted Liliana, was calmed by Tamiyo, and was attacked by Avacyn.
Later he shielded the Gatewatch's minds against Emrakul and helped bind her, and on Amonkhet his mind was nearly destroyed by Nicol Bolas, so that he planeswalked away blindly.
He woke on an island with no memory, was rescued by Vraska, regained his memories on Ixalan, judged Azor as Living Guildpact, and swore with Vraska to sabotage Bolas.

After the War of the Spark he was replaced as Living Guildpact by Niv-Mizzet, and in the assault on New Phyrexia he carried the sylex, was compleated, and was run through by Elspeth after he activated it.

He resisted phyresis from within his own mind, saved Vraska, recovered on Vryn with his mother Ranna, and with Vraska took the child Loot, whose mind holds a map of the Multiverse, in order to remake it.
In the Meditation Realm he tried to seize its power to save Vraska and shattered as the realm unmade itself, and later pieces of him rebuilt him with the need to build a better Multiverse.

status.text: Jace is dead: in the Reality Fracture story he died in Vraska's arms after his aberrations reintegrated, and his spark passed to Tam.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

timeline.summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
timeline.quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

timeline.summary: Lavinia shows Jace that victims of petrification were found in Rozlad Square arranged to spell his name.
timeline.quote: They spell out your name.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes that the victims' names match planes, realizes a planeswalker is targeting him, and insists on going alone to Rozlad Square.
timeline.quote: Clear out all your officers and mages from Rozlad Square. I'm going alone.

timeline.summary: Jace meets a hooded woman with a dagger in the square; she is petrified before he can read her mind.
timeline.quote: She became a stone statue before his eyes, a lifeless object.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals herself as a gorgon and planeswalker and says she wants Jace to prove he will be an ally of Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Before him was a gorgon.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Vraska wants to rule Ravnica, and she declares she is ready to kill him; the Jace she looks at is only an illusion.
timeline.quote: Instead of turning to stone, Jace melted away into nothingness.

timeline.summary: The real Jace emerges and has Vraska send her four assassins away; he deduces she wants to control him as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: So you want to leave me in the office of the Guildpact, and manipulate me.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

timeline.summary: Vraska strangles Jace with her tendrils; he reads her mind and conjures illusions of himself that attack her.
timeline.quote: Jace felt the gorgon's grip loosen as he sent image after image of himself at her.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies the illusions, which become a cage around her, and the statues speak in Jace's voice and trick her into explaining her plan to take over Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Then, one by one, I will assassinate the guild leaders.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

timeline.summary: Vraska crushes what she thinks is Jace's neck but it is her own petrified assassin; the statues close in and she blasts them away and planeswalks off.
timeline.quote: Then she took a breath, closed her eyes, and planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

timeline.summary: Ral leads Jace through the Undercity to show him something about Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek led the way through the sunken street

timeline.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ral designs a tracking enchantment on Jace's cloak and a storm over the Tenth that turns planeswalk pulses into lightning.
timeline.quote: The drizzle field would magnify the tracking enchantment's small pulses into detectable cracks of lightning overhead

timeline.summary: Ral explains to Jace why he hides Planeswalkers from Niv-Mizzet and resents Jace for becoming the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: An outsider, who had done no work at all.

timeline.summary: Ral and Jace watch from a Boros garrison for a Planeswalker Ral has been tracking, who does not appear.
timeline.quote: It's a Planeswalker I've been tracking.

timeline.summary: Jace confides that he does not remember his home and thinks of himself as Ravnican too, and Ral calls him Jace for the first time.
timeline.quote: That's the first time you've called me anything but 'Beleren.'

timeline.summary: Ral amplifies the storm atop Nivix, and the storm records Jace as a discontinuity while also placing him in the Tenth the whole time.
timeline.quote: The storm registered a discontinuity

timeline.summary: Flashback: An unnamed Planeswalker watches from the Boros garrison, overhears Ral and Jace's plan, and learns that the Living Guildpact is a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: The Living Guildpact was a Planeswalker. That much was certain.

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives in Ravnica at the Chamber of the Guildpact, intending to ask Jace for help, and collapses on the steps.
timeline.quote: Gideon ascended the first step, tried for another, but gravity had him, and he collapsed.

timeline.summary: Jace finishes a day of tedious petitions as the Living Guildpact and returns to his secret apartments.
timeline.quote: "Guildpact," said Lavinia. He turned. "Get some rest."

timeline.summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
timeline.quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

timeline.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
timeline.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
timeline.quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

timeline.summary: Jace and Liliana dine at Milena's, where she shows him the Chain Veil and he cannot take it.
timeline.quote: you can't take it, even if I wanted you to.

timeline.summary: Gideon, bloodied from battle, interrupts dinner and asks Jace for help with Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "Jace Beleren," he said. "I need your help."

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace Sea Gate has fallen and asks him to solve the puzzle of leylines.
timeline.quote: "Sea Gate has fallen."

timeline.summary: Jace admits to himself he inadvertently released the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Inadvertently released them from millennia of imprisonment to terrorize Zendikar

timeline.summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
timeline.quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

timeline.summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
timeline.quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
timeline.quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
timeline.quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
timeline.quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
timeline.quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace arrive at Vorik's camp and find slaughter and Eldrazi corruption everywhere.
timeline.quote: They stepped into carnage.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Jace from a pack of Eldrazi spawn and arms him with a sword.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaped between the Eldrazi and Jace.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges through hundreds of Eldrazi to reach a barricade of survivors and gets Jace over the wall.
timeline.quote: Gideon bellowed, "Zendikar!" and charged.

timeline.summary: Jace's telekinesis saves him from Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: knocked back by what must have been a telekinetic blow.

timeline.summary: Gideon sends Jace with the soldiers to find Jori En and holds the wall alone.
timeline.quote: look for a merfolk named Jori En.

timeline.summary: Jace reports that Jori En never reached the camp and may be trapped in Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: He thinks Jori En was among them

timeline.summary: Gideon, Tazri and the kor lead the wounded survivors up ropes onto the hedrons.
timeline.quote: They made the ascent with no complaints, no missteps, and no further injuries.

timeline.summary: Gideon sees Sea Gate's corruption from the hedron and resolves to go look for Jori En, leaving Jace to study the hedrons.
timeline.quote: And I'll find Jori En and bring her back here.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he trusts Gideon, and Gideon climbs down toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "I have to do this," he told himself, gripping the rope.

timeline.summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
timeline.quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

timeline.summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
timeline.quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
timeline.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

timeline.summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
timeline.quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

timeline.summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
timeline.quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

timeline.summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.
timeline.quote: "God damn it, Jace."

timeline.summary: Nissa recalls that Gideon and Jace did not understand her account of Zendikar's lost soul.
timeline.quote: She had told them that something horrible had happened to Zendikar's soul.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs a cliff in Akoum in search of the Tuktuk goblins and hauls himself over the lip straight into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: —and straight into an Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion fails against the Eldrazi, but Zada kills it with a blow from her pestle after a flash of blue light.
timeline.quote: just as a heavy club came down on its blank white head.

timeline.summary: Zada reveals she ground up a hedron to fuel her spell and tells Jace that hedrons hold magic.
timeline.quote: A hedron holds magic for a thousand years,

timeline.summary: Zada says Tuktuk is dead because she ate him, as goblins eat magic rocks to grow stronger.
timeline.quote: "I ate him," said Zada.

timeline.summary: Zada agrees to lead Jace to the Eye of Ugin, noting the hedron network has no center now.
timeline.quote: But I suppose I'll show you the way, if you think it's important,

timeline.summary: Zada leaves Jace at a cave entrance, warning that nobody goes in.
timeline.quote: Nobody goes in there. Bad magic. Certain death. Good luck!

timeline.summary: Jace descends into the ruined Eye of Ugin and sees a glow ahead and the stones growing orderly.
timeline.quote: the stones around him became more orderly

timeline.summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

timeline.summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
timeline.quote: It was not an accident,

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

timeline.summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

timeline.summary: Jace understands a circular glyph with three points that the leylines could be coaxed into forming.
timeline.quote: A glyph—circular, with three points at equal intervals around the circumference.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

timeline.summary: Jace privately realizes the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi fully into the physical realm so they could be killed, and keeps the idea to himself.
timeline.quote: You could pull him into the pond.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
timeline.quote: More like cells,

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

timeline.summary: Jace agrees but privately resolves to proceed his own way, and leaves the Eye with a plan.
timeline.quote: He had a plan. He had a destination. He was ready.

timeline.summary: Teysa recalls weeks earlier badgering the Living Guildpact into affirming twenty minor laws until he threw her out.
timeline.quote: After asking him to confirm no less than twenty minor laws and legal requirements

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

timeline.summary: Ebi brings Jace to the lighthouse, and Gideon embraces his friend.
timeline.quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

timeline.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

timeline.summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
timeline.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

timeline.summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
timeline.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares Jace's mind and illusion, and they locate the tilted hedron; Nissa leaps to it.
timeline.quote: The hedron was tilted; it must have shifted sometime after being carefully locked into place.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

timeline.summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
timeline.quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
timeline.quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

timeline.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

timeline.summary: The seawall heaves, the hedron ring shakes, and a stray hedron with dark power breaks a leyline.
timeline.quote: The circle was broken.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis senses a telepath in his head and strikes down Jace, breaking his cheekbone.
timeline.quote: my fist broke his cheekbone instead of taking his head off as I'd intended.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
timeline.quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
timeline.quote: Six dead.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

timeline.summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
timeline.quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

timeline.summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
timeline.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

timeline.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
timeline.quote: I'm not going anywhere,

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

timeline.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
timeline.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

timeline.summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
timeline.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
timeline.quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
timeline.quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
timeline.quote: I trust you,

timeline.summary: Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
timeline.quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that the Gatewatch has no plan for the third titan, Sorin, Nahiri or other threats like the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: these were threats that could only be handled by Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

timeline.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

timeline.summary: Nissa promises Zendikar's soul she will see it again and moves toward the others, agreeing to show Jace what she knows of Sorin.
timeline.quote: I will see you again,

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

timeline.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
timeline.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

timeline.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
timeline.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

timeline.summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
timeline.quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

timeline.summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
timeline.quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

timeline.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
timeline.quote: I'm certain

timeline.summary: Kiora empties the Halimar Sea and hurls it at Nissa, but Jace splits it into mist.
timeline.quote: But the sea split in two, and each half split in two

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

timeline.summary: Jace rides toward Stensia with a silent guide, complaining about Liliana and about needing her help.
timeline.quote: The jagged mountains of the province called Stensia loomed ahead of them

timeline.summary: Jace's guide transforms into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: His guide turned to him, accompanied by the stomach-churning sounds of bones cracking and clothes tearing.

timeline.summary: The werewolf kills its horse as Jace flees; howls answer from the woods.
timeline.quote: Behind him, the horse's scream was cut short with a wet crunch.

timeline.summary: A pack of werewolves chases Jace toward the manor.
timeline.quote: There were at least three of them bounding after him, hideous amalgamations of human and wolf.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a solid illusory bear that tackles one werewolf.
timeline.quote: A hulking bear made of shining blue light took form behind him

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of his guide's mind briefly, making it attack the pack's alpha, so the wolves fight each other.
timeline.quote: At last, the connection was complete. Jace was in control.

timeline.summary: A werewolf kills Jace's horse at the manor gate and Jace rolls clear.
timeline.quote: He was within shouting distance of the gate when the werewolf struck.

timeline.summary: Jace picks the lock on the manor gate with telekinesis and slips inside, and the werewolf leaves.
timeline.quote: Invisible mental fingers felt around inside the lock, found the tumblers, and quickly twirled them into place.

timeline.summary: Mindless zombies surround Jace in the yard, then part to let him pass into the house.
timeline.quote: In the darkness of the manor's yard, he could just barely make out a dozen figures standing silently around him.

timeline.summary: Jace is led to Liliana, who greets him and flicks his nose to check he came in person.
timeline.quote: She reached up to his face...and flicked the tip of his nose.

timeline.summary: Liliana disdainfully says there is worse than werewolves out there: angels.
timeline.quote: "Angels," she said with disgust.

timeline.summary: Jace claims he came to apologize for leaving Ravnica with unfinished business.
timeline.quote: I'm here to apologize.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he and Gideon saved a plane and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
timeline.quote: We even took an oath, to...to keep doing this.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees through Jace and refuses his freely given aid, forcing him to admit he needs something.
timeline.quote: I refuse your freely given aid, Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
timeline.quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse, but Jace insists it is his best lead.
timeline.quote: Markov Manor is the best lead I have.

timeline.summary: Liliana sets her zombie servants on Jace to make a point.
timeline.quote: Her zombie servants lurched forward.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusions and spells fail against the mindless dead and he is held helpless against the wall.
timeline.quote: Jace was helpless.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace the world is dangerous, then releases him and tells him to go home.
timeline.quote: Undead hands released him, and he rose, rubbing his throat.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace to stay the night rather than leave, then teases him that indifference would not quicken his heartbeat.
timeline.quote: doesn't make your heartbeat quicken or your face flush.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives at the shattered Markov Manor, hanging apart over a chasm with a broken bridge of stepping stones.
timeline.quote: Jace stood at the end of a long arched bridge that jutted out from the mountainside.

timeline.summary: Jace is briefly shown a vision of the manor as it once was; he cannot detect any mind causing it.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, he saw the place as it must have once been

timeline.summary: Jace uses telekinesis and balance to cross the floating stones to the entrance.
timeline.quote: He stepped off the edge of the bridge and planted his foot on a stone that hung in the air.

timeline.summary: Jace enters the manor's archway, carved with monsters and a giant vampire.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the archway and the stone walls enfolded him.

timeline.summary: A voice breaks the silence in the entry hall, asking Jace why he came; he cannot find its source.
timeline.quote: "Why did you come here?" A voice breaks the silence.

timeline.summary: Jace sees a memory of another living man in the hall and learns he is not the first living person there recently.
timeline.quote: I'm not the first living man to set foot in this hall recently.

timeline.summary: Jace finds a great hall of floating rubble with dozens of petrified vampires embedded in the stone.
timeline.quote: Dozens and dozens of them, trapped and petrified and encased in the stone.

timeline.summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
timeline.quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

timeline.summary: Jace finds the dead man's stone face and the journal he clutches to his chest.
timeline.quote: It's wrapped in blue leather, held shut with a red and green strap of silk.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the journal was written by a moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa and that Jenrik took it over and was sent to the manor to die.
timeline.quote: after she entrusted the journal to him and sent him here.

timeline.summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
timeline.quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

timeline.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
timeline.quote: Sorin made her.

timeline.summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
timeline.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
timeline.quote: This will help me find Sorin.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Jenrik brought the journal, was about to be caught by the vampires, and that someone tore the castle apart and trapped them all in the walls.
timeline.quote: Jenrik came to the castle carrying the journal

timeline.summary: Jace leaves Markov Manor with the journal.
timeline.quote: I turn my back on the darkness, pass through the soaring entryway, and leave Markov Manor.

timeline.summary: Jace reaches the Gavony moors in the rain, relieved from the delusions of Markov Manor, and starts reading the journal.
timeline.quote: It was still evening when he reached Gavony.

timeline.summary: Jace finds a twisted monolith on the moor matching those at Markov Manor and in the journal.
timeline.quote: The monolith was unmistakably the same as those he had seen at Markov Manor, the same as he had seen in the journal.

timeline.summary: A spark jumps from the monolith to Jace's hand, and he senses something bright and bell-clear.
timeline.quote: there was a POP and a spark jumped from the end of the monolith to his hand.

timeline.summary: On the Nephalian cliffs a vacant-eyed fisherwoman tells Jace that a 'she' has arrived with feathered ones from the sky.
timeline.quote: Brought her feathered ones from the sky, tide came up right on with them!

timeline.summary: Jace bridges minds with the fisherwoman and finds himself trapped in a featureless dome inside her mind.
timeline.quote: His form was somehow trapped in someone else's mind.

timeline.summary: A blind spot at the dome's center swells into a huge Object, and illusory duplicates of Jace appear around him.
timeline.quote: The blind spot in his vision had swelled to become an Object far larger than Jace himself

timeline.summary: The dome shatters, revealing a latticed wall of eyes; Jace awakens on the path while the fisherwoman flees.
timeline.quote: His eyes snapped open to find his hands clapped over his head, his body curled up on the ground.

timeline.summary: Jace sees the Drownyard, a huge ring of jagged stones in the ocean, and realizes all the cryptoliths point to it.
timeline.quote: All the cryptoliths point here!

timeline.summary: Jace is zapped by a stone again and perceives the Object hovering above the circle, the nexus of Innistrad's redirected leylines.
timeline.quote: A blind spot, the Object, loomed in his vision, hovering just above the circle of stones in the distance.

timeline.summary: One of Jace's duplicates takes the form of the soratami author of the journal and recites its words.
timeline.quote: The pale duplicate had reformed completely into a soratami—one of the moonfolk of Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: A swarm of angels descends over the Drownyard, dropping feathers.
timeline.quote: Huge winged things. Angels.

timeline.summary: The hooded duplicate walks into the sea and drowns, muttering questions.
timeline.quote: It continued moving doggedly forward as the waters closed over its head, entombing it below the surface.

timeline.summary: The violet-eyed duplicate reshapes itself into Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: slowly it rearranged itself to a familiar form: Liliana Vess.

timeline.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of redirecting the stones to herd and twist the angels, and she mocks him before vanishing.
timeline.quote: You're the one who redirected the stones to herd the angels here and twist their minds!

timeline.summary: The Liliana illusion dissipates into the night air.
timeline.quote: it suddenly dissipated into the cold night air.

timeline.summary: A dull buzzing voice tells Jace to stop asking questions and put away the journal, and he decides what he has to do.
timeline.quote: You don't need the book and its bottomless well of mysteries.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the intruding voice is Jace, who is invading her mind.
timeline.quote: Are you insane? I almost killed you!

timeline.summary: Jace binds Liliana's zombies with ropes of light so they cannot reach him.
timeline.quote: ropes of light bound their arms and legs, sent them toppling to the ground.

timeline.summary: Liliana's death magic passes through a Jace illusion, which pops.
timeline.quote: The bolt of purple light slid right through him, and his image popped like a soap bubble.

timeline.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of helping the angels at the Drownyard.
timeline.quote: And you're helping them. Admit it!

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Jace can see the Raven Man, and strikes the real Jace with a bolt of magic.
timeline.quote: She let loose a bolt of magic at Jace, the real Jace, that left him doubled over in pain.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil amplifies her magic and backlash racks Liliana as Jace presses his mental assault.
timeline.quote: The backlash started, agony suffusing Liliana as the Chain Veil took its toll.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace she does not want to hurt him; the pounding stops and the Raven Man vanishes in disgust.
timeline.quote: The Raven Man sighed in disgust and disappeared in a rustle of feathers.

timeline.summary: Jace, disoriented, tells Liliana about Markov Manor, the moonfolk journal and the stones pointing to a drownyard in Nephalia.
timeline.quote: A drownyard, on the coast.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes that Liliana is redirecting mana to the Drownyard to be rid of the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: These stone things are redirecting all this mana, and it's all going to this drownyard henge

timeline.summary: Liliana insists she had nothing to do with it, and Jace slumps in relief.
timeline.quote: I really didn't.

timeline.summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
timeline.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

timeline.summary: Liliana charges her hand with necromancy, and Jace grabs her wrist and aims it at his chest, daring her to kill him.
timeline.quote: and pointed her glowing palm at his chest.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace through a story of a pet that she would be sad when he dies but would get over it.
timeline.quote: Because that's how I'll feel when you're dead, you idiot,

timeline.summary: Jace leaves for Thraben, expecting to die there.
timeline.quote: Jace turned and walked away.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
timeline.quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
timeline.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

timeline.summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
timeline.quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: he didn't survive it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
timeline.quote: You need to leave, Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
timeline.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
timeline.quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
timeline.quote: In an instant, he knew her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
timeline.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

timeline.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
timeline.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

timeline.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
timeline.quote: And then she froze.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
timeline.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
timeline.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
timeline.quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

timeline.summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
timeline.quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

timeline.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
timeline.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

timeline.summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
timeline.quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
timeline.quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
timeline.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

timeline.summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
timeline.quote: This world is ruined,

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Innistrad, finds the sky tearing apart, and stands on a hill above burning Thraben.
timeline.quote: He could see the city now, and half of it was ablaze.

timeline.summary: Jace overloads the minds of three mad werewolves; two die and the third mutates into something unrecognizable.
timeline.quote: Whatever he had done had triggered some sort of reflexive mutation.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

timeline.summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
timeline.quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

timeline.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
timeline.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

timeline.summary: Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
timeline.quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
timeline.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

timeline.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
timeline.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Jace finds himself at the top of a spiral staircase in a copy of his Ravnica sanctum while Emrakul tears the tower apart.
timeline.quote: He was at the top of a long, grand spiraling staircase

timeline.summary: A voice in Jace's own voice commands him to go downstairs and he descends into the depths of the tower.
timeline.quote: He descended into the depths of the tower.

timeline.summary: Jace sees in a window Gideon, addressed as Kytheon Iora, questioned by the celestial Erebos, who threatens to kill his friends unless he says what he most desires.
timeline.quote: It is not an offer, mortal.

timeline.summary: Jace watches in a window as Emrakul's lattices cover Tamiyo's eyes, mouth and hands, erasing her ability to see, speak and write.
timeline.quote: She is being erased.

timeline.summary: Jace sees a vision of child Chandra surrounded by guards who say they killed her parents, and she burns them all.
timeline.quote: I can make the whole world burn.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Nissa mutated by Emrakul, ranting that growth is the answer, and she tells him she can do anything she wants.
timeline.quote: I can do anything I want. Anything at all.

timeline.summary: Through a door at the stairway's end Jace meets an angel he recognizes as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wonders whether she is Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I know this angel.

timeline.summary: Emeria offers Jace a game of chess: if he wins, all stops and she will give him answers.
timeline.quote: If you win, this all stops. I will give you all the answers you want.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmates her.
timeline.quote: He put his hand on his queen, moved it into position.

timeline.summary: Jace's chess pieces mutate and kill each other, and the angel says they were always her pieces and she no longer wants to play.
timeline.quote: They are all my pieces, Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Jace meets a copy of himself that makes him answer a riddle to prove he is Jace.
timeline.quote: No bigger than a pebble but my closing covers the entire world, what am I?

timeline.summary: Jace realizes he is not in a tower but is the tower, a mind spell he cast reflexively to shield everyone from Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I'm not in a tower. I am the tower.

timeline.summary: The copy explains it was a contingency Jace made to stay separate from himself and work out how to stop Emrakul.
timeline.quote: So I made a contingency plan to keep me separate from me

timeline.summary: The two Jaces merge; learning Liliana is about to die, Jace dissolves the spell and returns to reality.
timeline.quote: Jace dissolved the spell.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
timeline.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

timeline.summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
timeline.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

timeline.summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
timeline.quote: It was not going to be enough.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
timeline.quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

timeline.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
timeline.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
timeline.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects that Jace swore Lavinia to secrecy about planeswalking, and Lavinia guards him to keep him from leaving.
timeline.quote: to swear her to secrecy

timeline.summary: Liliana makes Jace drop his tidy glamour, revealing him tired and unkempt.
timeline.quote: You can drop the glamour, dear. No one cares.

timeline.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
timeline.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

timeline.summary: Baan asks who makes decisions for the group, and Jace and Gideon each fumble to name a leader.
timeline.quote: Gideon is the battlefield commander...

timeline.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
timeline.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

timeline.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
timeline.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon to investigate the petrifications and work with the Azorius.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to investigate this.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
timeline.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he hates it when she takes over, and she answers that she remembers when he enjoyed that.
timeline.quote: I remember when you enjoyed that.

timeline.summary: Jace returns from his paperwork and Lavinia hands him tea, anticipating his needs.
timeline.quote: It's my job to anticipate you, Guildpact,

timeline.summary: Baan voices his deterministic view that a criminal will forever remain a criminal.
timeline.quote: A criminal will forever remain a criminal.

timeline.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
timeline.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
timeline.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
timeline.quote: An irregular planeswalk.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

timeline.summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

timeline.summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
timeline.quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

timeline.summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
timeline.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

timeline.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
timeline.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
timeline.quote: My penthouse is safe.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

timeline.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
timeline.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

timeline.summary: Kari tells Jace she fights for pay as well as the cause; Jace says he is here only for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I don't fight for freedom, and I certainly don't fight for free.

timeline.summary: At First Launch, Ukti reveals that Pia's group lost the Aether Hub and leads Kari and Jace to her secret sanctum.
timeline.quote: "Pia's group lost the Aether Hub. They're all scattered now.

timeline.summary: Kari introduces Jace to the Derby Crows, who were at the Hub with Pia.
timeline.quote: They were called the Derby Crows.

timeline.summary: The Crows show the Skysovereign blockading the city and say the Heart of Kiran cannot get past it.
timeline.quote: "There's no way Heart of Kiran 's getting through that monster,"

timeline.summary: Jace says he has an idea after learning Kari knew her destroyed fleet well.
timeline.quote: "Then we have no time to waste. I have an idea."

timeline.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
timeline.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures an illusory fleet from Kari's memories of her destroyed ships, which fills the sky.
timeline.quote: Her fleet had returned to her, and they were assembling to fill the space above a plaza

timeline.summary: The Skysovereign engages the illusory fleet; its lightning cannon blinds Depala, and Jace links her to his mind so she can see.
timeline.quote: So instead, he returned a favor.

timeline.summary: Kari smashes jettisoned aether canisters, a skywhale rams the Skysovereign, and the flagship drifts to the ground.
timeline.quote: the whole thing listed to one side and drifted slowly to the ground.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims credit for Rashmi's invention and taunts Liliana about Jace and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She would have been sending vases across Ghirapur forever if I hadn't guided her tiny little mind.

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
timeline.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
timeline.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

timeline.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
timeline.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

timeline.summary: Gideon kills one wurm from the inside and is flung by another; Jace proposes retreating to Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: I ran forward and leaped into its open maw

timeline.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
timeline.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.
timeline.quote: "Only one way to find out."

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
timeline.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

timeline.summary: An aven vizier arrives to repair the barrier and questions their strange clothes; Jace reads his mind and bluffs a cover story about a faraway district.
timeline.quote: Well, of course, that's why I'm here in the . . . Nitin district, to teach you.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
timeline.quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

timeline.summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
timeline.quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
timeline.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

timeline.summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
timeline.quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
timeline.quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
timeline.quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

timeline.summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
timeline.quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

timeline.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
timeline.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

timeline.summary: Hiding in an alcove, Liliana and Jace watch mummies carry the freshly slain bodies of initiates down the corridor.
timeline.quote: The mummies carried the bodies of initiates slain in combat, dripping blood, wrapped in rags.

timeline.summary: They follow the mummies into the central chamber and see embalming on an industrial scale, which Liliana judges purely practical rather than religious.
timeline.quote: Not a religious rite. Purely practical.

timeline.summary: A corpse stirs before it is wrapped and the mummies silence it by pressing a metal cartouche to its chest.
timeline.quote: They pressed the cartouche into place on the body's chest.

timeline.summary: At a mural of the afterlife, Liliana and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate as the final test.
timeline.quote: Beyond the gate, Razaketh. Beyond Razaketh, paradise.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she is hunting Razaketh, and Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.
timeline.quote: You broke our trust.

timeline.summary: The carving of Razaketh opens its eyes and the mummies whisper Liliana's name, then attack her and Jace.
timeline.quote: The carving of Razaketh . . . opened its eyes.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace wrench a cartouche from a mummy, which bursts with white light and falls apart, and the mummies then surround them.
timeline.quote: The hole left by the cartouche burned with blinding white light, and the mummy fell apart.

timeline.summary: Temmet arrives, commanding the mummies, and reveals he checked the birth records and knows the pair are outsiders.
timeline.quote: But I checked the birth records at the Monument of Knowledge,

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of Temmet's mind, and through him the mummies, then urges Liliana to run.
timeline.quote: Jace was controlling Temmet, and Temmet was controlling the mummies

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

timeline.summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
timeline.quote: They work like leylines

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

timeline.summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
timeline.quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

timeline.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
timeline.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
timeline.quote: Got him, move fast,

timeline.summary: Liliana draws the Chain Veil but puts it away, choosing to defeat Razaketh with her own power.
timeline.quote: Let the demon witness what terror she could wield all on her own.

timeline.summary: Jace is horrified as Liliana laughs and relishes the killing, and he tells her to stop.
timeline.quote: Liliana, that's enough

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Jace she ate Razaketh and that only one demon remains; Jace does not answer.
timeline.quote: And now there's just one more.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he will not stand by if she loses control like that again.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to stand by if you lose it like that again.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Bolas's mind but is lured into a trap and the dragon squeezes his mind.
timeline.quote: The obsidian shield disappeared, and Jace fell unexpectedly into Nicol Bolas's mind.

timeline.summary: Facing mind-death, Jace blindly planeswalks away across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Without conscious thought, he began planeswalking away blindly, not knowing or caring where.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in a bamboo grove on an island with no memory of how he arrived or of his own name.
timeline.quote: He did not know how he had gotten here. He did not know his own name.

timeline.summary: Jace instinctively tries to planeswalk away, but a massive force yanks him back and a circle-and-triangle sigil appears above him.
timeline.quote: only to feel himself yanked backward, pulled by some massive force back through whatever metaphysical door he had begun to walk through

timeline.summary: Jace finds deliberate, surgical scars on his right forearm and back.
timeline.quote: A scar ran in a perfect line down his right forearm.

timeline.summary: A fire Jace wills into being gives no heat and vanishes in blue light; he concludes he has gone insane.
timeline.quote: The man solemnly concluded that he had gone insane.

timeline.summary: Jace sees visions of people from his forgotten past, among them a woman in violet who makes him anxious.
timeline.quote: he would sometimes see a woman in violet on the edge of his field of vision

timeline.summary: Jace realizes his visions are illusions he casts himself and that he is a mage.
timeline.quote: I'm not hallucinating—I've been creating illusions!

timeline.summary: An illusion of a raven-haired woman in violet tells Jace he was never a leader or a detective, only a frightened child playing pretend.
timeline.quote: you were a frightened child playing pretend

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of his magic, ending his involuntary illusions, and resolves to become whoever he wants to be.
timeline.quote: Whoever I was is irrelevant, for I will become whoever I want to become.

timeline.summary: Jace builds a raft and sails away from Useless Island.
timeline.quote: Useless Island disappeared over the horizon, and infinite azure stretched out in front of him.

timeline.summary: A storm wrecks Jace's raft and he washes up on a barren rock covered in seabirds.
timeline.quote: Exhausted and defeated, the man kicked himself over toward his new home.

timeline.summary: Descending into his own mind, Jace finds his spark, the one part of himself his memory loss did not take.
timeline.quote: a shining light embedded in the well of his mind

timeline.summary: Jace tries to planeswalk again and is pulled back once more by the same sigil.
timeline.quote: Once again, he felt himself violently tugged backward

timeline.summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
timeline.quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
timeline.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he does not remember anything before waking on an island, and she concludes it is not an illusion.
timeline.quote: I don't remember anything from before I woke up on the first island.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides not to kill the harmless Jace and tells him he can stay until the next harbor.
timeline.quote: We'll prepare a hammock for you in the forecastle,

timeline.summary: Jace accidentally touches Vraska, who flinches because she has not been touched in years.
timeline.quote: She had not physically touched anyone in years.
