timeline.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
timeline.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

timeline.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
timeline.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

timeline.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
timeline.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to stay with her crew, and he accepts.
timeline.quote: I would love to.

timeline.summary: Jace spends days learning sailing and honing his illusions among the crew as the ship sails.
timeline.quote: He set about making a place for himself among the crew and relished learning new tasks and techniques.

timeline.summary: The Belligerent lands at High and Dry, where the crew disembarks for revelry.
timeline.quote: the crew landed at High and Dry with no need for expensive supplies.

timeline.summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
timeline.quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
timeline.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace he is something else entirely.
timeline.quote: You're something else entirely.

timeline.summary: Jace asks if he can read minds, and Vraska confirms telepathically; he learns to silence the voices.
timeline.quote: Yeah, you can.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
timeline.quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Jace half-remembers a winged lion with a man's face and worries about the minds he may have broken.
timeline.quote: I wonder how many minds I have broken before,

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
timeline.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

timeline.summary: Jace encourages Vraska that she is meant to be a great leader, and each realizes neither wants to hurt the other.
timeline.quote: Both of them realized at the exact same moment that neither of them wanted to hurt the other.

timeline.summary: Jace disassembles and repairs the thaumatic compass, then triggers his planeswalker spark and sees the needle point at him.
timeline.quote: And felt his body break apart and away and slam back together, with the familiar triangle appearing above his head once more.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes the compass points to a specific kind of magical expression and that Orazca must be a massive hub of such energy.
timeline.quote: the Golden City would have to be a massive hub of magical energy

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

timeline.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
timeline.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
timeline.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

timeline.summary: Jace puts a charging vampire to sleep with his mind magic.
timeline.quote: The vampire in front of him stumbled in the sand and collapsed to the ground, snoring.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
timeline.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

timeline.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
timeline.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

timeline.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
timeline.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
timeline.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
timeline.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
timeline.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
timeline.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

timeline.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
timeline.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

timeline.summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
timeline.quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

timeline.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
timeline.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
timeline.quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

timeline.summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

timeline.summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace abandoned their boat the next morning.

timeline.summary: A vampire conquistador ambushes them under a cloud of dark smoke.
timeline.quote: A thick cloud of dark smoke suddenly flooded the grove around them.

timeline.summary: Jace dispels the darkness spell and Vraska fights the exposed vampire while Jace conjures an illusory storm.
timeline.quote: The dark smoke dissipated, leaving a conquistador standing exposed.

timeline.summary: The vampire knocks Jace down and steals the thaumatic compass, fleeing into the jungle.
timeline.quote: snagging the thaumatic compass from the ground at Jace's feet

timeline.summary: Jace goes to track the vampire but hears the minds of Tishana and Huatli pursuing it.
timeline.quote: What he heard instead was a pair of furious internal monologues.

timeline.summary: Tishana's illusory flying snake crashes into Jace's psychic defense.
timeline.quote: An immense, illusory, flying snake crashed into his arms and split on either side of Jace's psychic defense.

timeline.summary: Tishana snares Jace with vines, breaking his illusion.
timeline.quote: vines whipped up from the forest floor to wrap themselves around Jace's legs.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
timeline.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

timeline.summary: Jace tells them the vampire took the compass, and Tishana and Huatli leave to hunt it.
timeline.quote: The vampire took the compass from us.

timeline.summary: Vraska explains how the crew caught up, using Malcolm in the sky and Jace's telepathy.
timeline.quote: It's much easier to find shortcuts with an eye in the sky and a telepath on the ground.

timeline.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
timeline.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
timeline.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

timeline.summary: Jace loses his grip on a boulder and tumbles down the waterfall as Vraska reaches for him.
timeline.quote: the ground jerked sideways once more, and Jace lost his grip.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace's memory of becoming the Living Guildpact at the Forum of Azor.
timeline.quote: It was the day Jace became the Living Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace is regaining all his memories and fears their friendship will dissolve.
timeline.quote: He would remember he was the Guildpact and she was an assassin and their friendship would certainly dissolve.

timeline.summary: Jace lies bleeding on the riverbank, his mind broadcasting memories.
timeline.quote: Jace lay in agony on the riverbank.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace's injury has left his mind unable to contain his memories.
timeline.quote: He broadcasted his memories now in bursts and stops, clearly trying to wrestle them back under control.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a half-metal man scarring Jace's back and forearm.
timeline.quote: dragged a manablade in long, arrow-straight lines down his back, then one single line down his right forearm

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

timeline.summary: Vraska witnesses a memory of Jace asking a woman in violet if she will be sad when he dies.
timeline.quote: Will you be sad when I die?

timeline.summary: The woman in violet gives a cold answer, then pours drinks and toasts to new good old days to keep Jace there.
timeline.quote: To new good old days,

timeline.summary: Jace chokes out the name Vryn as a memory of his home plane floods in.
timeline.quote: He choked out a single word.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of Jace's mother reading to him as a toddler.
timeline.quote: She was reading to her toddler from a notebook as she wandered the tiny kitchen

timeline.summary: Vraska sees that Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks and mentally violated every time he remembered.
timeline.quote: the realization he had been forced to forget his first planeswalk

timeline.summary: Vraska experiences Jace's memory of facing the sphinx Alhammarret on a rooftop.
timeline.quote: the sphinx Alhammarret was crouched to attack in front of her.

timeline.summary: Jace's mind-strike collapses Alhammarret's mind in a catastrophic implosion (flashback).
timeline.quote: What was a well of weathered marble violently collapsed against itself in a catastrophic implosion that deafened the senses.

timeline.summary: Jace's own memories are ripped away in the psychic backlash.
timeline.quote: But Jace had struck out too hungrily, too hard, and his own memories were ripped away in the process of psychic demolition.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret, mind destroyed, screams like an infant.
timeline.quote: It was the terrified howl of an infant.

timeline.summary: Jace instinctively planeswalks away, losing more memories as he goes.
timeline.quote: Jace began to instinctively planeswalk away

timeline.summary: Only the image of the sphinx's collar symbol remains in Jace's memory.
timeline.quote: All that remained was the image of the sphinx's collar

timeline.summary: Vraska holds the weeping Jace, the first time she has touched anyone willingly in years.
timeline.quote: Vraska instantly dove to the ground and scooped him into her arms.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
timeline.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska as a menacing figure the first time they met.
timeline.quote: It was the first time they had met.

timeline.summary: Jace says Vraska saw everything and acknowledges she is an assassin; she answers she is also a friend.
timeline.quote: You're an assassin

timeline.summary: Jace says his memory is not fully back and has gaps.
timeline.quote: It's not all back. There are gaps.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska for trying to kill him.
timeline.quote: I forgive you for trying to kill me,

timeline.summary: Jace says the last three months were the best of his life.
timeline.quote: It was the best three months of my life.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace the person who listened to her is who he really is.
timeline.quote: That Jace is still in you, and I think that Jace is who you really are.

timeline.summary: Jace speaks of his mother wanting him to be a scholar.
timeline.quote: My mother wanted me to move to the city to be a scholar.

timeline.summary: Vraska helps Jace up and they start to climb the staircase to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Vraska held out a hand to help Jace to his feet.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he used to be a coward as they climb.
timeline.quote: I used to be a coward.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs the golden stairs to Orazca, exhausted and in control of his memories.
timeline.quote: He deliberately placed each foot ahead of the other as he ascended the stairs to Orazca

timeline.summary: Jace recalls trying to break into a golden dragon's mind and his own being erased (memory).
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into a dragon's mind.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Ugin bidding him farewell (memory).
timeline.quote: Good fortune, Jace Beleren

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass at the top of the stairs.
timeline.quote: What we need is in there.

timeline.summary: A huge flying creature rises over Orazca while Jace hides them with an illusion.
timeline.quote: An immense dinosaur's head towered over the city.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes his earnest self on Ixalan is who he always was.
timeline.quote: That was who he had always been. He had just forgotten.

timeline.summary: Jace remembers his mother and hopes she is alive.
timeline.quote: He liked being able to remember his mother.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he recalls the skills his mentor taught him.
timeline.quote: I can remember the skills my mentor taught me, now.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
timeline.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

timeline.summary: Jace solves the maze on the tower's back door.
timeline.quote: Jace started to trace the solution to the maze, a line of blue magically trailing his fingers as they moved.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Jace senses a sphinx's mind inside the room.
timeline.quote: This person's mind was familiar, labyrinthine, a mind like only one he had ever encountered before.

timeline.summary: Vraska promises telepathically that no sphinx will hurt Jace again.
timeline.quote: You'll never be hurt by a sphinx ever again,

timeline.summary: The sphinx in the throne room announces himself as Azor and threatens Vraska.
timeline.quote: I am Azor, the Lawbringer,

timeline.summary: Jace shields Vraska's mind from Azor.
timeline.quote: Jace slammed a psychic ward between the sphinx and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Jace declares himself the Living Guildpact and Azor recoils, calling him the fail-safe.
timeline.quote: I am Jace Beleren, the Living Guildpact,

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm hear Jace and the floor gives way beneath the standoff.
timeline.quote: Malcolm, you heard Jace too?!

timeline.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.
timeline.quote: If this gorgon is not my prisoner, then who have you brought for me to seal?

timeline.summary: Azor binds Vraska with law magic through Jace's ward, but Jace frees her.
timeline.quote: A binding of glowing white runic magic grabbed hold of her torso and shoved her back toward the door behind them.

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
timeline.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

timeline.summary: Azor attacks Vraska and Jace; Vraska cuts his leg.
timeline.quote: Vraska unsheathed her sword and cut a long thin line across Azor's back leg.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Azor's mind with a migraine.
timeline.quote: manipulate Azor's mind, sending the feeling of a piercing migraine through the sphinx's head.

timeline.summary: Jace takes responsibility to judge Azor as Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: It is my responsibility to act on behalf of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
timeline.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

timeline.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island, never to leave or meddle again.
timeline.quote: You will be the master and caretaker of Useless Island.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
timeline.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska share everything they know about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Jace told Vraska everything he knew about Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

timeline.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
timeline.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Jace shows Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into Nicol Bolas's mind.

timeline.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
timeline.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

timeline.summary: Bolas scrambles Jace's memories, but a trap Jace's mind carried sends him to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a part of Jace's mind propelled him from Amonkhet to Ixalan.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks Jace to take and hide her memories of him so Bolas will not see them.
timeline.quote: I need you to temporarily take my memories of you.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes the plan is to betray Bolas.
timeline.quote: You want to betray Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Vraska lays out the plan to accept Bolas's offer of guild leader and wait until Jace restores her memories.
timeline.quote: He promised me the title of guild leader.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Oubevir's Maneuver can hide the gap in Vraska's memories.
timeline.quote: It's a way to smooth over evidence of mental tampering.

timeline.summary: They choose Niv-Mizzet as the one to help devise the plan.
timeline.quote: He could challenge Nicol Bolas both physically and mentally

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska swear oaths to keep her memories safe and to sabotage Bolas when they are returned.
timeline.quote: I swear to commit my conscious self to his destruction.

timeline.summary: Jace says he must meet his friends on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: I need to meet my friends on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jace sends Vraska's message to her crew, leaving Amelia in charge.
timeline.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

timeline.summary: Jace promises to call Vraska Captain before restoring her memories.
timeline.quote: I'll call you Captain.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to a date at Tin Street Market and he accepts.
timeline.quote: It's a date.

timeline.summary: Jace seals Vraska's memories of him in a warded box hidden in her mind.
timeline.quote: She saw her memories of Jace tied up in a bundle, placed within a box, sealed with an unbreakable ward.

timeline.summary: Jace stays invisible as the Sun vanishes and the others leave.
timeline.quote: Jace had shrouded himself in invisibility as the Immortal Sun vanished

timeline.summary: Jace sends Malcolm a farewell message for the crew.
timeline.quote: Captain is safe, but far away

timeline.summary: Jace thinks of the promised coffee and book with Vraska.
timeline.quote: His mind drifted to the promise of coffee and a book.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that Ravnica must come first.
timeline.quote: Ravnica must come first.

timeline.summary: Jace chooses to track Gideon rather than Liliana to reach Dominaria.
timeline.quote: What he felt for her now wasn't anything resembling affection.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks and lands aboard a fast-moving vessel on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jace stepped through the aether forcefully and immediately caught himself on a wall.

timeline.summary: Gideon is overjoyed to see Jace alive.
timeline.quote: Gideon! I'm not dead!

timeline.summary: An older woman in red robes blocks Gideon and asks who Jace is.
timeline.quote: Who's the bookworm?

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches, told by Jace to let Vraska go, find Orazca empty (non-canon pirate ending).
timeline.quote: Captain's orders are to let her go, Breeches.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks onto the moving Weatherlight and warns that Bolas is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Ajani wanted us to meet and regroup, but Bolas is preparing a trap for Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

timeline.summary: Jace leaves alone, warning Gideon not to be a fool as he was.
timeline.quote: "Don't be a fool, Gideon. Like I was."

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
timeline.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

timeline.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
timeline.quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

timeline.summary: Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
timeline.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

timeline.summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

timeline.summary: Gideon adds a sixth problem, protecting ordinary Ravnicans, and Zarek adds a seventh, reconstituting the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: We need to reconstitute the Guildpact by uniting all ten guilds.

timeline.summary: An Izzet goblin warns that a God-Eternal with an army is approaching; Jace calls for volunteers for six missions while Zarek asks Kaya to help with Operation Desperation.
timeline.quote: one a' them God-Eternals approaches, at the head of a small army of those undead creepies!

timeline.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
timeline.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to return to New Prahv and reactivate the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas bolting.
timeline.quote: We want you to return to New Prahv and turn the Immortal Sun back on.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace reunite and agree to try a relationship after Bolas is dead or they are.
timeline.quote: So tomorrow we give it a try . . . after Bolas is dead or we are?

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet tells Jace the Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: The Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
timeline.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

timeline.summary: Nissa asks Jace to help convince Nahiri to destroy the core, but Jace wants to study it and does not listen.
timeline.quote: I need Nahiri to destroy the lithoform core when she finds it.

timeline.summary: Nissa declares she will protect her home with or without the Gatewatch and planeswalks back to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I'm going to protect my home. With or without the Gatewatch's help.

timeline.summary: Jace, keeping the secret that Bolas lives, plans to go to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: That the ancient, terrible dragon was still alive.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives in Sea Gate looking for Nissa and meets Mara at the memorial.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked to the massive platform with its six upright hedrons.

timeline.summary: Jace discloses the situation to Kesenya, who refuses help but secretly writes Murasa on a note.
timeline.quote: But scrawled on the bottom of the parchment, there was a single word: Murasa .

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Murasa and is attacked by a mushroom-backed monster using echolocation.
timeline.quote: Something large was tearing through the fauna behind him

timeline.summary: Nissa's harabaz elemental destroys the monster, saving Jace.
timeline.quote: Within seconds, the harabaz elemental destroyed the monster

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to join Nissa in climbing the Skyclave to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Yes," he said. "I'm ready.

timeline.summary: Nissa catches Akiri in a bramble and hauls her onto a ladder of branches.
timeline.quote: there was a bramble branch curled tightly around her chest

timeline.summary: Akiri realizes Nissa and Jace are planeswalkers, and learns Nahiri has the Core.
timeline.quote: I've met Nahiri. She's the one who pushed me.

timeline.summary: Jace tries a mind attack on Nahiri, who retaliates with a boulder; Akiri saves Jace by swinging them back onto the ladder.
timeline.quote: Look out!" Akiri shouted, pushing Jace out of the way

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that Nahiri went north, and Jace reveals he read her mind: she is going to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She's going to the Singing City.

timeline.summary: Nissa goes ahead alone on jurworrell roots, vowing to stop Nahiri and destroy the Core.
timeline.quote: I will stop Nahiri and destroy the Core,

timeline.summary: Jace promises to take the Core beyond Zendikar and Akiri agrees to lead him to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: I'll take you to the entrance of the City so you can help Nissa

timeline.summary: Jace enters the Singing City and meets Nahiri, who refuses to give up the Core and attacks him.
timeline.quote: Never," she snarled.

timeline.summary: The city's haunting song nearly drives Jace mad until he casts a silencing spell that also saves Nahiri.
timeline.quote: A spell that blocked out any sound entering his ears.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals through telepathy that she will channel the Core through the city's focal point, and Jace agrees not to hinder her if she holds off using it until they study it.
timeline.quote: Runes said there's a magical focal point there that can channel the Core's energy all over Zendikar through the leylines.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
timeline.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri; Nahiri hurls swords at Nissa.
timeline.quote: Nahiri created dozens and dozens of glowing swords.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the elementals, speeding along Zendikar's paths, cut them off at the city gates.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is where I belong. It's the heart of my power and strength,

timeline.summary: The elementals surge forward as the battle for Zendikar's soul begins.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar's soul had begun, and it would be a ruthless fight.

timeline.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

timeline.summary: Jace slips into the city as Nahiri walls off the entrance with stone.
timeline.quote: a massive wall of stone crushing the marble gates of the city

timeline.summary: Nahiri builds a fortress; Jace pleads to go to Ravnica but she traps him in a ring of hedrons.
timeline.quote: trapping Jace within the dangerous ring

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Sorin and attacks, but it is a Jace illusion, and Jace seizes control of her mind.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, her thoughts were not her own.

timeline.summary: Jace takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri's satchel and resists its temptation.
timeline.quote: Took the Lithoform Core.

timeline.summary: Jace escapes the city with the Core, but Ashaya pins him and tosses the Core to Nissa.
timeline.quote: And into Nissa's waiting hands.

timeline.summary: Nissa speaks mind-to-mind with Jace while the Core's voice, which is Zendikar itself, speaks to her.
timeline.quote: I am me. I am you.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes Jace is trying to take control of her mind, snaps the link and has Ashaya hold him down.
timeline.quote: Jace was trying to take control of her mind.

timeline.summary: Nahiri berates Jace and planeswalks away; Jace resolves to apologize to Nissa.
timeline.quote: He didn't try to argue as the ancient kor turned and planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Jace absent from his house but is greeted by Teferi, who guesses she has not slept.
timeline.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

timeline.summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
timeline.quote: Then I'm coming with you.

timeline.summary: Jace links the strike team telepathically, and Nissa finds a tiny artifact bird, resolving to keep watch for every plane.
timeline.quote: For the life of every plane,

timeline.summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
timeline.quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

timeline.summary: Jace says Nissa was shunted away by a trap, as if forced to planeswalk again.
timeline.quote: a trap shunted her away

timeline.summary: Jace states that the plan stays the same: get the sylex to the base of the World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: If we don't get the sylex to the base of their World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities, all the planes will share Mirrodin's fate.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, hearing Karn and Ajani are missing, notes that both know too much about the sylex.
timeline.quote: Ajani destroyed the last one.

timeline.summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
timeline.quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he is not sure the plane will survive the sylex but says there is no time for a new plan.
timeline.quote: No. No, I'm not.

timeline.summary: Jace confesses the plan is to set off a bomb in the center of the plane, and Melira agrees to help provided they do not lie about the risk.
timeline.quote: We're setting off a bomb in the center of the plane.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
timeline.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
timeline.quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

timeline.summary: Jace wakes and tries to run off, saying Vraska is in pain and calling to him.
timeline.quote: She made it down here, and she's alone and she's scared.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

timeline.summary: Jace uses illusions so that Phyrexians locked in civil war cannot see the group as they cross the battlefield.
timeline.quote: When they look at us, they see nothing at all,

timeline.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
timeline.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

timeline.summary: The group finds Vraska, gravely wounded and surrounded by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: bleeding profusely from a dozen terrible wounds, stood Vraska.

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace she is already infected and begs him to flee, saying she loves him.
timeline.quote: Run, Jace Beleren, and don't look back.

timeline.summary: Nahiri slices Jace's pack straps and Kaya snatches the sylex; the group leaves Jace and Vraska behind.
timeline.quote: Nahiri snapped her fingers.

timeline.summary: Jace casts an illusion of a sunny Ravnican avenue so that he and Vraska can spend one more day together.
timeline.quote: The coliseum was gone, replaced by a sundrenched Ravnican avenue

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals Jace is also infected and kisses him as the illusion ends.
timeline.quote: You're as doomed as I am.

timeline.summary: Vraska, now loyal to Phyrexia, stabs Jace's hand with a scorpion-like tail dosing him with oil, and Jace flees.
timeline.quote: For the glory of Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Nahiri exposes her infected neck and declares she will move the mission forward by force.
timeline.quote: The mission only goes forward if we move on .

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

timeline.summary: Lukka arrives in the wrong location on New Phyrexia, separated from the strike team, and recalls why he joined the mission.
timeline.quote: He wasn't with the rest of the strike team.

timeline.summary: Jace says through telepathy that he will not risk the mission to save his own life.
timeline.quote: I'm not risking us all to save my own life, not when we've already lost Vraska.

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

timeline.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
timeline.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Jace collapses and Tyvar carries him into the tree's root cavity.
timeline.quote: scooped the other man into his arms

timeline.summary: Karn tells them the invasion is still young and that they must detonate the sylex at the root source.
timeline.quote: You will need to get to the root source and detonate it.

timeline.summary: Jace volunteers to take the sylex, saying it is too late for him too, and heads for the doorway with Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Let me take the Multiverse from them.

timeline.summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

timeline.summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
timeline.quote: Jace didn't look good.

timeline.summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
timeline.quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

timeline.summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
timeline.quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

timeline.summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
timeline.quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

timeline.summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
timeline.quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Jace refuses to wait, saying Vraska is dead and he is dying and that the sylex must be detonated.
timeline.quote: Vraska is dead, and I am dying,

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
timeline.quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

timeline.summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
timeline.quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

timeline.summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
timeline.quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs what she thinks is the sylex, but it dissolves like mist because it was another of Jace's illusions.
timeline.quote: only for the sylex to dissolve in her hands like mist.

timeline.summary: Hidden by illusion, Jace pours his grief, Mirrodin's agony and his love for Vraska into the sylex and speaks the words to activate it.
timeline.quote: Wipe the land clear. Bring the ending,

timeline.summary: Elspeth drops through the ceiling and runs Jace through with her sword, taking the sylex.
timeline.quote: she drove her blade through Jace and shoved him aside

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
timeline.quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.

timeline.summary: Teferi reads Eshe's memory of the dead comrades, learning that the guards are themselves bandits who killed ten.
timeline.quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

timeline.summary: The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
timeline.quote: He became one of them,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains that Elspeth ran Jace through and took the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ran him through, picked up the sylex and planeswalked into the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Vraska recalls singing with Jace on a boat on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: It is night on Ixalan, and I sing to the vast and buzzing jungle.

timeline.summary: Vraska enters her old apartment and finds the thaumatic compass, recalling the days before the War of the Spark when she reopened her memories of Jace.
timeline.quote: It is the weeks before the War of the Spark

timeline.summary: In her mind Vraska meets Jace at a café, remembers luring and betraying him, and tells him she deserves to die; he lets her share her memory.
timeline.quote: I betrayed him. I transformed him.

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska and tells her the part that led the invasion was not her, entering the corner of her mind he made.
timeline.quote: "The you that kissed me wasn't you.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace share a kiss on a dreamed beach, a do-over, and Jace tells her he loves her too before a white light erupts.
timeline.quote: "I love you, too, captain."

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Jace's defeat on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He fought as hard as he could, but he lost. And because of that, we all lost.

timeline.summary: Teysa's remark about walking away stirs Kaya's memory of Jace and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Teysa had managed to invoke the shades of Jace and Vraska, the other two people who'd walked away from Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's illusion drops, revealing Jace Beleren, who puts Annie to sleep.
timeline.quote: The darkness evaporated, and beneath Ashiok's hooded cloak was Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Jace shatters the pod and takes the sleeping infant from the vault.
timeline.quote: Jace scooped up the child in his arms, cradling it to his chest.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Oko, who planeswalks away before the stone reaches his head.
timeline.quote: "Your services are no longer required,"

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
timeline.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.

timeline.summary: One year earlier, Jace stands at the Invasion Tree with his hands on the sylex, convinced the Multiverse must restart.
timeline.quote: Jace has his hands on the sylex, Phyrexia will succeed in their invasion

timeline.summary: Jace says goodbye to Kaya and Kaito and chooses not to command them to sleep.
timeline.quote: His last kindness in all their last breaths will allow them their agency.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the sylex, surrenders, and cuts himself to pour his misery into it.
timeline.quote: Jace grasps the sylex and, as he does, surrenders.

timeline.summary: Jace is compleated, and his Phyrexian self takes control while his mind retreats inward.
timeline.quote: the compleation is final

timeline.summary: In his mind, Jace finds a safe copy of Useless Island, then is pulled back into the physical world by a riptide.
timeline.quote: it appears he made, deep inside himself, a holdout for his mind

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in his body with a sword through his chest, and plays dead behind an illusion.
timeline.quote: Jace glances down and sees a sword sticking through his chest

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn offers his friends a place among the One, and Tyvar, Kaito and Kaya refuse.
timeline.quote: "Enemies it is," Elesh Norn concludes.

timeline.summary: Jace skims Elesh Norn's mind and learns she has commanded him to go home to Vryn.
timeline.quote: Go home , commands the Mother of Machines, go home.

timeline.summary: Jace's body planeswalks to Vryn as phyresis reclaims him.
timeline.quote: His body exits the aether of the Blind Eternities and steps onto the wet soil of a plane he hasn't seen in years.

timeline.summary: On the beach in his mind, Jace commands his body to fight the oil as a virus.
timeline.quote: THE OIL IN YOUR VEINS IS A VIRUS.

timeline.summary: Jace briefly sees through his body's eyes at Vryn, where his Phyrexian self has seized dozens of soldiers.
timeline.quote: Twenty soldiers seize in front of him, their minds singing to Jace's in a static cacophony.

timeline.summary: Jace commands his body to sleep and succeeds.
timeline.quote: YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in a ravine feverish, tears out a cable from his arm and decides to save Vraska.
timeline.quote: he grasps one of the cables in his arm and rips it out.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians, and searches for Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: Ravnica is at war, again

timeline.summary: Jace finds Vraska wounded and compleated on a rooftop, and learns she has hidden herself in a mental recess.
timeline.quote: Her body is a mess of broken burned chrome.

timeline.summary: Jace performs five simultaneous telepathic feats to reverse Vraska's phyresis and carries her into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he closes his eyes and performs five miracles at once.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska collapse in the home of Jace's mother Ranna, a healer.
timeline.quote: Ranna Beleren, ever in control, hides her alarm at the bleeding monsters that fell into her living room.

timeline.summary: Jace pleads with his mother for help before passing out.
timeline.quote: Please help us, Mom. I'm so sorry.

timeline.summary: On Vryn, Ranna Beleren tends to Jace and Vraska, who arrive bleeding on her floor; Vraska asks her to save Jace first.
timeline.quote: "Save him first," Vraska rasps

timeline.summary: Ranna telepathically asks whether Vraska is Jace's wife, and Jace answers that she is his world.
timeline.quote: She is my world, mother.

timeline.summary: Ranna casts a ward and sedates the pair with a song.
timeline.quote: Ranna whispers to them both a song of sedation

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in his old bedroom and explains he gave them fevers to burn out phyresis; Ranna reveals Vryn thought he died with Alhammarret.
timeline.quote: We all thought you died with him.

timeline.summary: Jace shows his mother his memories, and she asks if he killed Alhammarret; his expression answers yes.
timeline.quote: Ranna nods for him. " Good ."

timeline.summary: Ranna uses a phoenix feather to heal Vraska, and Jace learns his parents separated.
timeline.quote: It's a phoenix feather.

timeline.summary: Jace overhears Ranna telling Vraska that the old her is dead, mentioning a warrant for Jace's execution.
timeline.quote: The old you is dead. You can never be that person ever again.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, disguised, visit an Omenpath on Vryn and decide something must be done about the portals.
timeline.quote: "Jace. We have to do something."

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska decide the Multiverse is too broken to fix and settle on a rebirth plan inspired by phoenix feathers.
timeline.quote: "So, what if we do something other than fix it."

timeline.summary: Over months they accept their old lives are over and agree that rebirth is the just option.
timeline.quote: But rebirth … rebirth does both.

timeline.summary: Nine years earlier, young Jace is sent by Tezzeret to the Fomori vault and senses a childlike mind within.
timeline.quote: he feels a mind deep within the vault, sleepy with torpor, childlike and quiet.

timeline.summary: Two years earlier, Tamiyo offers to tell Jace the story of the vaults, relics of an ancient empire.
timeline.quote: Relics of an ancient empire long lost to history.

timeline.summary: Before leaving Vryn, Jace and Ranna say goodbye and promise weekly contact.
timeline.quote: "Once a week," Ranna says

timeline.summary: Vraska discovers she can no longer planeswalk, and Jace confirms her spark is gone.
timeline.quote: "I can't feel it. I can't feel it anymore."

timeline.summary: Jace vows to make meaning of their own; Vraska plots their plan on the wall.
timeline.quote: She turns her grief into purpose with furious alchemy

timeline.summary: A month earlier, Jace baits and knocks down Proft on Ravnica to link minds with him.
timeline.quote: Jace turns, swings the pipe as best he can, and feels satisfying contact as he knocks Proft to the ground.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
timeline.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
timeline.quote: "His name is Loot."

timeline.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
timeline.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
timeline.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

timeline.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
timeline.quote: Ours will be better.

timeline.summary: Ral, back on Ravnica, vows to kill Jace for hiding as Ashiok and stealing a creature, and tells Tomik his plan to seek help.
timeline.quote: Beleren is alive, and I'm going to kill him.

timeline.summary: Ral returns to the ruins of Tarnation and finds a faint trace of Jace's aether trail.
timeline.quote: Ral focused on that trace with every part of himself.

timeline.summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
timeline.quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

timeline.summary: Helga describes her vision of Jace with a green and black lizardfolk and a hard-to-see creature, and Ral decides to keep her in sight.
timeline.quote: Right now, you're my only link to Beleren, so I'm not letting you out of my sight.

timeline.summary: Ral pledges to keep the group alive as long as Helga is his link to Jace.
timeline.quote: so long as Helga is my only link to Beleren, I'll be sure to keep you all alive.

timeline.summary: Kaito senses someone approaching and punches Jace in the face.
timeline.quote: he whirled, driving his right fist square into the face of the slender, dark-haired man who'd been walking up behind him.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
timeline.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

timeline.summary: A groaning sound fills the basement and Kaito and Jace stand back to back, agreeing to fight later.
timeline.quote: Jace and Kaito both stiffened, instinctively falling into position back to back

timeline.summary: A tentacled nightmare crawls from the basement wall toward Jace and Kaito.
timeline.quote: some terrible, shapeless, tentacled thing began to crawl out and into the room where they both stood.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the nightmare's mind and says it is a nightmare given substance.
timeline.quote: This is a nightmare given substance.

timeline.summary: Jace dissolves the nightmare by taking away the dreamers' fear.
timeline.quote: I reached into the dreamers I felt inside it and took their fears away.

timeline.summary: Jace apologizes for vanishing after the invasion and says he is searching for Vraska.
timeline.quote: I've been traveling with Vraska and our new companion.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaito fall into a pit of stinging gel.
timeline.quote: the floor gave way beneath their feet and they fell, not into nothingness, but into a pit filled with some thick, gelatinous substance

timeline.summary: Manacles clasp Kaito's ankles as he touches a rung.
timeline.quote: shouted as he felt manacles clasp around his ankles.

timeline.summary: Himoto picks the locks on Jace's shackles.
timeline.quote: Himoto began working at the locks on Jace's shackles, manipulating the tumblers until they clicked open.

timeline.summary: A projection on the ceiling shows Vraska shielding a small creature from blade-bodied monsters.
timeline.quote: There, projected on the ceiling, was Vraska, shielding a small, orange-furred creature with her body

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Kaito in the pit, climbing the rungs and triggering the manacles that pull Kaito down.
timeline.quote: Before Kaito realized what was happening, Jace began to climb.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Niv-Mizzet that Jace left him.
timeline.quote: He said he was sorry, and he left me.

timeline.summary: Vraska pulls Winter from the Speed Demons' wreck.
timeline.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.

timeline.summary: Jace compels Winter to go limp and searches his mind for Loot.
timeline.quote: With another wave of his hand, Jace compels him to go limp.

timeline.summary: Vraska says they promised to keep Loot safe.
timeline.quote: We promised to keep him safe.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to take Winter prisoner as a loose end.
timeline.quote: I think we need to take him prisoner.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees Jace flanked by the Consulate's goons, with Vraska at his side.
timeline.quote: Her eyes find him where she least expected him: flanked on either side by the Consulate's powerfully muscled goons.

timeline.summary: Jace raises a hand and Loot's eyes go blank.
timeline.quote: Jace raises a hand, and the little guy's eyes go blank.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to hand Loot over to Jace.
timeline.quote: I told Loot I would look after him,

timeline.summary: Jace sends armored guards to attack Chandra.
timeline.quote: A wave of his hands sends the armored toughs charging straight at her.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fireball passes through an illusion of Jace.
timeline.quote: An illusion. Of course.

timeline.summary: Jace casts a spell of misty white that turns the wrecked racers' eyes white and makes them attack Chandra.
timeline.quote: Spirals of magic flash around Jace; a net of misty white surrounds the racers still pulling themselves from the wrecks.

timeline.summary: Jace unleashes a punishing mind attack on Chandra and the others.
timeline.quote: Whatever magic Jace is using against her is nasty stuff

timeline.summary: Jace picks up the little creature from Chandra's crumpled form.
timeline.quote: He watches as Jace picks up something from Chandra's crumpled form—a little creature of some kind.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
timeline.quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

timeline.summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
timeline.quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

timeline.summary: Nissa begs them to stay but a magical fog covers their escape.
timeline.quote: But by then, a haze of magical fog overtakes the clearing, and Nissa knows it's no use.

timeline.summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
timeline.quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
timeline.quote: He is a map of everything .

timeline.summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.
timeline.quote: What I needed to.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska urges Jace to stop using Loot's mind, saying Loot keeps trying to hide from him.
timeline.quote: He keeps trying to hide from you.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Jace admits he reaches into Loot's mind, Vraska compares it to what he did to Chandra, and they argue over whether the cost is worth it.
timeline.quote: You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.

timeline.summary: Vraska begs Jace to let the dead rest, and Jace refuses, insisting he must fix everything.
timeline.quote: I know what I have to do.

timeline.summary: In a later flashback, Jace pursues Loot into a dragonstorm and puts him under with magic against his will.
timeline.quote: wrapping him in an unbroken blue light

timeline.summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
timeline.quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

timeline.summary: Jace, who has already shifted to an illusory double, seizes the gem between Ugin's horns and an explosion of light follows.
timeline.quote: Jace closed his hands over the gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
timeline.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

timeline.summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
timeline.quote: I've got you,

timeline.summary: Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
timeline.quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

timeline.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
timeline.quote: It was Vraska herself.

timeline.summary: Jace, wielding the stolen power, shows glimpses of lost futures, but the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.
timeline.quote: revealing a nothingness that ate at the eye

timeline.summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace has died.
timeline.quote: It was such a small word.

timeline.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
timeline.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: So Bolas escaped.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Jace is alive,

timeline.summary: Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, upsetting Chandra.
timeline.quote: He didn't just die; his essence was unmade .

timeline.summary: Chandra says Jace is manipulating archaics as the giant archaic appears overhead.
timeline.quote: Manipulating archaics!

timeline.summary: Elsewhere in the tunnels, Chandra and Ajani argue; she tells Ajani she believes Jace plans to use the huge archaic.
timeline.quote: "I think it's the archaic. The big one."

timeline.summary: Chandra asks Ajani to help her find and kill the huge archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees to support her.
timeline.quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Chandra insists the culprit is Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's Jace! I'm telling you, it's Jace."

timeline.summary: Chandra says Jace is no longer her friend and Ajani argues they cannot turn their backs on him; she rebukes him.
timeline.quote: I get to decide who my friends are, Ajani,

timeline.summary: The guide introduces Jace's attempt to rewrite reality and the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren, Planeswalker and mind-mage, is attempting to rewrite reality with his own vision for existence.

timeline.summary: The original plan fails and Jace is unmade in the Meditation Realm, but pieces linger and rebuild him with the need to build a better Multiverse.
timeline.quote: When our original plan failed, Jace was unmade in the Meditation Realm.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind and reassures her, and she finds a textbook with Jace Beleren's name in it.
timeline.quote: JACE BELEREN is scrawled in a child's hand in the upper-left corner.

timeline.summary: Vraska lives with Ranna and Loot on Vryn, mourning Jace and wracked by guilt for turning away from him.
timeline.quote: Mostly what plagues her is guilt. She turned away from him.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace knows he is going to die.
timeline.quote: Jace knows he is going to die.

timeline.summary: The aberrations reintegrate into one and Jace opens his eyes, whole again.
timeline.quote: Plural becomes singular. The aberrations, the parts, become one.

timeline.summary: Jace gives each of his friends a final message, and Liliana forgives him.
timeline.quote: Liliana smiles. I'm sorry, Jace. Rest unburdened.

timeline.summary: The overlay's threads fade as the knife in his heart ends the false Multiverse's tether.
timeline.quote: Above, the orrery has paused, the threads tying the two Multiverses together fading with the beating of his heart.

timeline.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms, unafraid, after thanking her.
timeline.quote: In the quiet of the sanctum with the now separated orrery overhead, Jace goes still.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds Jace's body and weeps as Chandra and Ajani embrace her; Liliana kneels and mourns him.
timeline.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns for Vraska and Jace's body and they haul him through the mage-ring away from the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Together, Liliana and Vraska haul Beleren's body through the mage-ring, away from the false Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Jace's voice speaks in Tam's mind, telling her she is his fail-safe and she inherits his spark.
timeline.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

timeline.summary: For many years Jace had no memory of his childhood; those memories are now restored.
timeline.quote: For many years, Jace had no memory of his childhood. Although those memories are now restored

timeline.summary: Jace chooses not to read the true intentions of those around him so as not to erode his friends' trust.
timeline.quote: Jace could easily read the true intentions of those around him, but he recognizes that doing so would erode the trust of his friends

timeline.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

relations.note: Lavinia is Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber.
relations.quote: formerly the Azorius maze runner and currently Jace's aide and deputy at the Chamber of the Guildpact

relations.note: Vraska tries to coerce or kill Jace; he outwits her.
relations.quote: I'm ready to kill you now.

relations.note: Jace is the Living Guildpact, embodiment of the concord between the guilds.
relations.quote: He was the embodiment of the concord between Ravnica's guilds

relations.note: Hardly friends at first, they cooperate to keep Planeswalkers secret.
relations.quote: He just hoped the plan he and Jace had come up with worked.

relations.note: He is the Living Guildpact.
relations.quote: Jace Beleren was the so-called Living Guildpact, the arbitrator of all the guilds

relations.note: Jace's friend, who no longer remembers him.
relations.quote: "She doesn't remember?"

relations.note: Liliana was the first real lover he had; they are estranged.
relations.quote: She was also the first real lover he'd ever had

relations.note: His bailiff.
relations.quote: said his bailiff, Lavinia

relations.note: Agrees to help Gideon on Zendikar.
relations.quote: "Of course," said Jace. "Tell me everything you know."

relations.note: Shared a house and a bed before she betrayed him.
relations.quote: They had shared a house, and a bed, in one of Ravnica's poorer districts.

relations.note: They met recently on Ravnica and travel together.
relations.quote: "Met recently, on Ravnica."

relations.note: Gideon brought him to Zendikar and Jace says he trusts him.
relations.quote: "I do," Jace said, with a touch of wonder in his voice.
